queries.sql:
SELECT log_id, run_id, timestamp, event_type, account_code,
               entity, bu, period, version, previous_value, new_value,
               formula_used, input_values, triggered_by, user_id, module
        FROM CALC_AUDIT_LOG
        WHERE version = 'actuals'
        ORDER BY timestamp DESC
        LIMIT 100

SELECT OVERRIDE_ID AS LOG_ID, NULL AS RUN_ID,
               CREATED_AT AS TIMESTAMP,
               OVERRIDE_TYPE AS EVENT_TYPE,
               ACCOUNT_CODE, DIM_PRIMARY AS ENTITY, DIM_SECONDARY AS BU,
               PERIOD, CAST(VERSION_ID AS VARCHAR) AS VERSION,
               PREVIOUS_VALUE, NEW_VALUE,
               BREAKBACK_METHOD AS FORMULA_USED,
               NULL AS INPUT_VALUES,
               PARENT_OVERRIDE_ID AS TRIGGERED_BY,
               USER_ID, MODULE,
               CONFIDENCE, RATIONALE, SIGNAL_SOURCE, SEVERITY, PROPOSAL_ID
        FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_OVERRIDE
        
        ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
        LIMIT 100
